data.name: El Ministerio del Tiempo VR: El tiempo en tus manos
data.detailed_description:
“Time on your hands” is a Virtual Reality experience in which you live from within one of the best Spanish TV series, “the Ministry of Time”. In this experience, you will be able to get into the Ministry’s Headquarters and meet forehand some of the characters of the series. In the game, you are applying to enroll the Ministry and therefore you will have to sit an exam and pass an interactive test which will tell if you are prepared enough to become a member of a ministry’s patrol. Over 10 minutes, you will stroll along several rooms of the ministry gazing around. After crossing the main secret gate, you will encounter the Cloister where you will be met by one the chiefs of the Ministry. Ernesto Jimenez. He will lead you to the office where Angustias, the secretary is receiving the candidates.

The exam will take place at the Director’s office, who will overlook the applicants, you included. You will have to answer several questions related to the Spanish history and the plot of the series.

If you pass the exam, the Ministry’s ID will be given to you in order to access downstairs area. After going down the famous snail staircase, you will find corridors inhabited by members of the ministry from different Eephocas-from Cavemen to roman soldiers, or medieval monks. Only at the end of you journey, you will find the Doors of the Time.

reviews.review:
I did view this experience seated, without any controllers or gamepad.  You can select all options by gazing at the menu options.  The few interactions within the experience can also be selected by gazing at them.  This is cinematic experience about a TV show in Spain called a "Ministry of Time: Time is in your hands," so yeah it's about time travel or Dr. Who - Spanish edition.  

The default option is Spanish and all audio is in Spanish.  Luckily, I speak fluent Spanish.  However, there is also an English option to turn on subtitles (look behind you in the menu to select this option).  The unfortunate part is that the English subtitles will take away from the immersion as the subtitles are huge and in the way most of the time.  If you move, the subtitles will be blurred when you move.

Part of this experience is an exam.  Option A is a psychological exam.  You want to choose A because option B is an exam that requires specific knowledge of either the show or Spanish culture/history.  I think there's also an option X, but I didn't do a 3rd playthrough to find out what it is.  Spoiler alert: [spoiler] it really doesn't matter what you choose as you'll still "pass" and get accepted into the ministry of time [/spoiler]

I think this experience is geared for fans of this show.  So I think most people won't be too interested in this experience unless you just really want to see 360 video.  The video quality is okay, not great.  You can see jaggedness/blur of objects at a distance.  The show does this fade out after sequences that is a bad idea for VR.

Rating 5/10 It's free and it's for fans of the show .... so very tepid recommendation here, experience better in Spanish
